    # AGENTS.md instructions for /workspace
    
    <INSTRUCTIONS>
    # Russell research workspace — agent laws (SELECT v2, reset 2026-08-07)
    
    Orientation for ANY agent: `/workspace/INDEX.md` → `docs/PLAN_SELECT_V2.md` →
    `artifacts/workflow_memory/open_work.json`. Hidden conversation context is not evidence;
    reconstruct from committed artifacts, receipts, and `research/review_records/`.
    
    ## Data walls (never negotiable)
    - Six token corpora under `/workspace/data/tokens/` (sha-pinned stock-quote registry
      `233dc10a…`; other corpora calendar-bounded by the same 1,003-session registry).
      **2026 payload is never read.** 2020–21 warmup is out of scope for science.
    - Preserved input authorities: the event publication (`e1_rel037_verified_event`),
      `events.4_stage_run/pub`, the action book + outcome panel, entry path targets,
      opportunity set, fold registry, cost tables, oracles (see INDEX keep-table). Read-only.
    - IWM is the only scientific clock/price. No RTY market payload in fitting, features,
      labels, calibration, diagnosis, or promotion (RTY-mini numbers are scenario arithmetic).
    
    ## Build constitution (amended 2026-08-07 by the approved SELECT v2 plan)
    - **Value-per-budget replaces maximality**: native grain is honored in the STREAMING PASS
      (every token read); outputs are curated, budgeted summaries (≤64 cols/family). "Best build"
      = most measured value per budget. Exhaustive coordinate grids are forbidden.
    - Every feature family: mechanism hypothesis → op-count projection + per-session wall budget
      BEFORE implementation → probe on a real slice → leakage harness (4 controls) →
      two-run byte-identity → Holm-corrected rank gate on dev folds → provisional keep/kill
      (finalized by leave-one-family-out). Cost is a gate column; >20% of pipeline time = kill.
    - Fixtures via production constructors only; a test not shown to FAIL is not evidence;
      no fallback path ships without one real execution on the production substrate.
    - Typed states, never silent drops; denominators immutable; scientific choices never
      tie-break by hash/ID.
    - DRY, lean; identity budget = git sha + input sha + one output manifest per publication.
    
    ## Evaluation law
    - THE evaluator: uncapped one-position confidence-gated replay (labels are already net:
      576¢/RT + adverse-side fills embedded — receipt in the action book's red_declaration).
    - Folds: `fold_registry_v2` (embargo=2). Fold 7 is BURNED (contaminated-confirmatory label
      mandatory). Dollar-based selection is forbidden under 200 inner-val sessions; differences
      <$100/session are unresolvable; concentration columns (leave-top-10-out, min-year) are
      promotion preconditions. Preregistration = committed spec; the runner refuses dirty specs.
    - Forward escrow 2026-07-16+ opens only per the protocol in the plan (PART IX.6).
    
    ## Roles and routing
    - Architect (this session's owner): specs, briefs, adjudication, integration.
    - Implementers: Sonnet/Opus agent lanes on exact specs, sparse worktrees for concurrent writes.
    - Adversarial review: fresh-context refute-first lanes at high effort; reviews recompute
      headline numbers, never trust reports. Sol-era routing is retired (2026-08-03).
    
    ## Ops
    - Compute law: neobox truth — 16 vCPU stated / 13.6 cgroup, 282GB RAM, ~97GB VRAM, single
      box. (The historical 12-vCPU/54GB/18GB text in PROJECT_GOAL.md was the dead box's research
      envelope — retired 2026-08-07; deployment envelopes are a PROVE-stage question.)
    - Storage: RunPod dashboard is the only authority; deletions via committed manifest rows
      (hook-enforced), hardlink-aware sizing, no trash window on this volume.
    - Long jobs via `lab/run.sh` (pid+hb+rc) + watchdog cron; exact-PID kills only.
    - `CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/workspace/artifacts/cache/ctpool-a`; /tmp is the 30GB container overlay.
    - Run ledger `artifacts/project.db` is bookkeeping, never authority. Published artifacts:
      `artifacts/runs/<name>/` with manifest + receipt.

    <proposed_plan>
    # Clean Action-State Rebuild to the $2,000 Floor
    
    ## Summary and diagnosis
    
    The authoritative baseline is the clean `select-v2` lineage at `ab3940bc`. Main-branch fold-based Python experiments and mixed matrices are historical evidence only.
    
    The reset did not fail to reach the goal; it never implemented the system required to attempt it:
    
    - The live binary only provides `emit`, `f4-pilot`, and `calendar`. It has no trainer, label join, calibrator, policy, or economic replay.
    - Emission drops the action’s `LOW/HIGH` side. Across the current family artifacts, 166/198 columns are identical for opposing actions at the same cutoff. A learner therefore mostly sees market state without knowing which trade it is valuing.
    - Full emission uses reduced projections of only stock quotes and trades. Option prints, RUTW prints, RUTW quotes, rich AllGreeks, OI, and rates never reach a full learner.
    - The stock pass invents quote-before-trade ordering at equal milliseconds. The option pilot concatenates expiry shards instead of merging them chronologically and can use the final stock quote of a second for an earlier option event.
    - Current outputs have no immutable producer/input identity and permit overwriting. That allowed reset and later fold-era artifacts to coexist under the same run root.
    - The historical “generalization, not features” conclusion concerns discarded aggregate matrices. It does not test the reset’s missing side-aware, causal, raw-state architecture.

This proves availability, not learnability, but it places the bottleneck at representation and selection rather than candidate capacity.
    
    The floor lane will use the existing dense candidate set and fixed 15-minute exits first. Adaptive exits and alternative candidates begin only after either reaching the floor or proving that timing—not selection—is the remaining loss.
    
    ## Implementation plan
    
    ### 1. Establish a clean lineage, truth spine, and evaluator
    
    - Branch from `select-v2@ab3940bc` as `select-v2/action-state-rebuild`. Add a new `select_live` Rust crate and Python package; leave `select_v2`, the main-branch lab, old matrices, and fold registry read-only.
    - Create immutable output roots keyed by configuration hash. Every publication is written to staging and atomically renamed, refuses an existing destination, and records Git SHA, dirty-patch SHA, command, configuration, ordered schema hash, every consumed input/hash, session range, file hashes, and producer version.
    - Replace opaque ordinal logic with explicit types:
    
      - `ActionKey { session_ordinal, cutoff_bar_ordinal, extreme_side }`
      - `TradeDirection::Long` mapped only from `LOW`
      - `TradeDirection::Short` mapped only from `HIGH`
      - `PairedTarget { long_net, short_net, directional, common_drag, pair_state }`
      - `directional = (LOW_net − HIGH_net) / 2`
      - `common_drag = (LOW_net + HIGH_net) / 2`
      - `LOW_net = common_drag + directional`
      - `HIGH_net = common_drag − directional`
    
      No action ordinal, ID suffix, or row parity may infer side.
    
    - Republish a keyed, derived truth bundle from the preserved action book and entry-path panel. Preserve censored and unpaired rows as typed states; train the paired objective where both sides exist and a masked direct-value objective otherwise.
    - Implement the floor evaluator independently in Rust:
    
      - Fixed 15-minute occupancy and the matching already-net `term_net_cent_15m`.
      - Chronological one-position replay; no hard trade cap.
      - At one cutoff, consider both sides together and select at most one.
      - Exact score ties abstain; IDs and hashes never break scientific ties.
      - Costs are not added again.
      - Equity starts at zero, includes zero-trade/warmup days, and calculates cumulative EOD drawdown against a zero-inclusive running peak.
      - Emit every selected action, exit time, realized net, daily equity, drawdown, trade count, yearly results, leave-top-10-out mean, and concentration statistics.
    
    - Acceptance before modeling: reproduce the $4,178.65 hindsight-threshold result and $5,734.88 exact oracle from the preserved targets, then demonstrate failures after deliberately changing occupancy, side mapping, or cost handling.
    
    ### 2. Compile a causal state substrate from the actual raw information
    
    The first full compiler will consume:
    
    - The six token feeds: IWM stock quotes/trades/options prints/options quotes and RUTW options prints/quotes.
    - IWM and RUTW minute AllGreeks surfaces.
    - IWM and RUTW pre-open open interest.
    - The six local FRED rate series.
    - No 2020–2021 science and no 2026 path or payload.
    
    Reader and clock rules:
    
    - Retain every causal source field needed for state, conditions, venue, sequence, quote age, Greeks, IV, and flow. Explicitly ban `price_lead_1`.
    - Use the stock trade’s attached, strictly prior NBBO for classification. Never manufacture cross-stream ordering for equal timestamps; equal-time events form an unordered timestamp group.
    - K-way merge all option-expiry shards by timestamp. Shard filename order must not affect output.
    - Use stock spot strictly before each option event. Never use a whole-second terminal quote for an earlier event in that second.
    - Reject or type-mask future/stale attached timestamps, including the observed RUTW underlying-timestamp exceptions.
    - Reconstruct option sweeps causally. Vendor whole-sweep counts and sizes become verification fields and are not visible until the sweep’s final member has occurred.
    - Treat invalid, one-sided, locked, crossed, unknown-condition, and missing rows as distinct states.
    - Use OI only when its physical timestamp precedes the session open; otherwise carry the previous available observation. Publish unsigned exposure and both sign scenarios—never assume dealer direction.
    - RUTW is contextual input only. IWM remains the action clock, executable price, and P&L authority.
    
    State representation:
    
    - Produce a per-session one-second tensor for fast state and a one-minute tensor for slow state, both with parallel validity/quality masks and strict half-open time boundaries.
    - Fast blocks contain stock quote state, classified stock prints, IWM/RUTW option prints, and IWM/RUTW quote revisions: prices/returns, spreads, depth, additions/cancellations/refills, signed and unresolved flow, condition classes, venues, sweep completions, Greek/premium flows, arrival structure, and within-second first/last/run statistics.
    - Slow blocks contain session path, causal realized-volatility terms, surface level/skew/curvature/term structure, exact bid/ask-IV width where invertible, IV–RV state, higher Greeks, OI concentration/scenarios, prior-available rates, forward-volatility state, clock, and modality quality.
    - All normalization statistics are fitted from prior sessions during training, never globally during compilation.
    - Write memory-mappable Arrow shards plus a paired action index. Every action row carries its explicit side/direction and offsets into the state tensors.
    - Compile a 20-session production-format pilot first. After causal and performance gates pass, compile the core information set corpus-wide; the much larger raw option-quote pass follows immediately as a measured add-on and must complete before the available information set is declared exhausted.
    
    ### 3. Build the selector in two controlled stages
    
    First, build two fixed XGBoost controls:
    
    - A corrected aggregate baseline using the current reset families after rejoining explicit side. This measures what the old aggregation can actually support without folds.
    - A causal state baseline using recent-window summaries from the new tensors. Fit paired directional/common-drag mean and quantile targets. Use one fixed GPU configuration and early stopping on prior-only sessions; no random hyperparameter search.
    
    Then build the primary PyTorch model:
    
    - A compact hierarchical causal state encoder, kept below roughly five million parameters.
    - Each fast modality receives a six-block depthwise causal TCN over the previous 240 seconds, with kernel 5, dilations 1/2/4/8/16/32, width 32, SiLU, group normalization, and 0.10 dropout.
    - Slow minute state is processed online by a two-layer GRU with width 128 across the session-to-date sequence.
    - Modality embeddings are fused by two four-head attention layers at each cutoff. Missing modalities use masks, not zeros.
    - The slow branch produces the directional proposal prior. The fast branch produces a bounded confirmation update `2*tanh(x)`; it can strengthen, weaken, or reverse the prior but cannot independently create unbounded value.
    - Heads output mean and 10/50/90% quantiles for directional advantage, common drag, and per-side adverse excursion. Derived outputs provide both side-value distributions and calibrated probability of positive net.
    - Training combines Smooth-L1 mean loss, pinball quantile loss, paired side-ranking loss weighted by clipped payoff separation, adverse-excursion loss, and supervised contrastive loss using same-session/time-matched profitable and inert actions.
    - Regularization uses session-balanced batches, modality dropout, causal time masking, price-scale invariance, and LOW/HIGH reflection augmentation.
    - Before supervised fitting, pretrain the encoders on prior-only sessions with masked-channel reconstruction and same-time versus time-shifted cross-stream discrimination. This learns present multi-stream state without future labels.
    - Use deterministic PyTorch, AdamW at `3e-4`, weight decay `1e-3`, cosine decay, at most 30 epochs, and five-epoch early stopping. Architecture and hyperparameters freeze before the official prequential replay.
    
    Policy:
    
    - When flat, calculate each side’s calibrated `q10(net)`, `P(net>0)`, and `q90(adverse excursion)`.
    - Require `q90(adverse excursion) ≤ $200`.
    - At each 21-session update, choose `P(net>0)` from `{0.50, 0.55, …, 0.90}` and a `q10` threshold from prior-score percentiles `{50,60,70,80,90,95,97.5,99}` using only the preceding 63 prior-only predictions.
    - A gate is admissible only if that trailing replay has positive mean and MDD no greater than $750. Select the highest mean; differences below $100/session tie, then the higher-confidence/fewer-trade gate wins. If none qualifies, abstain for that block.
    - At a cutoff where both sides qualify, take the side with larger `q10`; exact ties abstain. Trade count remains entirely emergent.
    
    ### 4. Run the fold-free proof and localize every shortfall
    
    Prequential protocol:
    
    - Sessions 0–61 seed the first model.
    - Generate warmup predictions causally for sessions 62–82, 83–103, and 104–124, retraining only on earlier sessions. These 63 predictions seed calibration.
    - Official scoring covers sessions 125–1002: 878 sessions. Retrain every 21 sessions on an expanding prior-only window; score the entire next block before admitting any of its outcomes.
    - Normalizers, representation pretraining, fitting, calibration, and policy selection obey the same cutoff.
    - Report both:
    
      - Mean on the 878 actually scored sessions.
      - Contract-equivalent mean over all 1,003 sessions with the 125 warmup sessions entered as zero. This preserves the original denominator and requires approximately $2,285 per scored session to clear the historical $2,000 floor.
    
    Promotion requires all of:
    
    - Zero-filled 1,003-session mean net at least $2,000.
    - Mean on the 878 scored sessions at least $2,000.
    - Cumulative EOD MDD strictly below $1,000.
    - No hard trade cap and exact one-position chronology.
    - Positive results in every calendar year reported, with concentration and leave-top-10 results disclosed.
    - Every score row identifies the model’s training cutoff and passes provenance validation.
    
    Required ablations use the identical protocol:
    
    - Aggregate baseline.
    - Slow proposal only.
    - Fast confirmation only.
    - Slow plus fast stock.
    - Add IWM option prints/surface.
    - Add RUTW cross-stream state.
    - Add OI/rates/forward-volatility state.
    - Add raw option-quote confirmation.
    
    If the floor is missed, route by measured decomposition:
    
    - Good paired direction but weak replay: repair calibration, timing, occupancy, or risk—not features.
    - Good direction and risk but poor fixed-15-minute economics: build state-change exits using the exact path authority.
    - Good signals whose value occurs between minute cutoffs: create a new sub-minute action book around detected transitions with fresh executable labels.
    - Train-only signal: reduce capacity and strengthen session/reflection invariance; do not reopen random feature grids.
    - No cross-session side signal after full raw-state and positive controls: inspect per-modality and cross-stream alignment losses, then test a learned transition candidate set. Do not use the discarded aggregate matrix to declare the raw data exhausted.
    
    After the first floor champion is frozen, pursue the “past the floor” lane by raising confidence to reduce median trades without a cap, then add state-change exits and multi-horizon value heads. The frozen floor champion remains untouched. The next promotion target is $3,000/session, MDD below $1,000, and median trades below ten.
    
    ## Test and escrow plan
    
    Mandatory tests include:
    
    - `LOW → long` and `HIGH → short`, demonstrated through the production target constructor; action-ID parity mutations must fail.
    - Post-cutoff raw perturbations leave every score byte-identical.
    - Shard permutation and equal-time cross-stream permutation leave tensors identical.
    - No option event sees a same-second future stock quote.
    - Whole-sweep vendor totals cannot appear before sweep completion.
    - Source condition, venue, unit-era, and missing-state mutations affect only their declared channels.
    - LOW/HIGH reflection swaps the two predicted value distributions.
    - Two identical compiler/model runs produce identical tensor and score artifacts.
    - A deliberately leaked future-return channel succeeds strongly; shuffled labels, shifted streams, and session permutations collapse to null.
    - The corrected aggregate and raw-state models use identical truth, calibration, policy, and replay.
    - 2026 paths are refused before escrow authorization.
    
    Escrow is two-stage and one-shot:
    
    1. Freeze and commit code, state schema, model, normalizers, calibrator, gate, input manifest, and expected output schema before opening any 2026 file.
    2. On authorization, compile and score the fixed 2026-07-16+ tranche, seal the score hash, and only then open outcome labels for replay. No retraining or threshold change is allowed between scoring and evaluation.
    
    The economic floor becomes confirmed only if the frozen escrow replay also produces at least $2,000/session and MDD below $1,000. Sample size and uncertainty are reported without changing the economic pass criteria.
    
    ## Implementation workflow and archive side quest
    
    - The root architect retains every scientific and architectural decision and writes an exact task card for each bounded implementation batch.
    - Every implementation batch is delegated only to `gpt-5.6-luna` with reasoning effort `max` and minimal forked context. Luna receives exact files, interfaces, formulas, failure cases, commands, and acceptance outputs; it does not select architecture or interpret results.
    - The root personally reads every diff, checks it against raw schemas and targets, runs the mutation test plus the full relevant suite, and accepts or rewrites the batch before issuing the next card.
    - Markdown, AGENTS instructions, skills, and Claude reports remain context only. No claim enters a task card without code, raw-data, or receipt-level verification.
    
    The archive is an early but separate task:
    
    - Build one importable, path-filtered Git fast-export covering all local branches/tags and unpushed commits, plus current authored text changes, source/configuration, every Markdown file, selected manifests/receipts, and a ref/SHA map.
    - Include tiny 2025-only schema samples with two or three rows for the six token feeds and the AllGreeks/OI/rate inputs used by this plan.
    - Exclude raw payloads, all 2026 data, generated matrices/runs, caches, worktrees, compiled targets, vendored binaries, secrets, media, and oversized Git blobs. Include an omission manifest and restoration instructions.
    - Package as a single `.tar.zst` with a hard 55 MB target, run `runpodctl send <archive>`, and return the receive code.
    - Do not rewrite local Git history or attempt the GitHub cleanup as part of this archive. The failed push is caused by tracked build artifacts and requires a separately authorized history rewrite.
    
    ## Assumptions
    
    - `select-v2@ab3940bc` is the sole current implementation baseline.
    - The preserved action book and entry-path targets remain read-only outcome authorities, but their fold columns are ignored.
    - No 2020–2021 data is used for scientific fitting, and no 2026 payload is read before escrow authorization.
    - The locally installed PyTorch and XGBoost stacks are used; the empty TabPFN environment and absent local checkpoint are not placed on the critical path.
    - The proven 418-bps availability establishes the physical opportunity, while reaching the causal floor remains something the new prequential and escrow protocols must earn.
    </proposed_plan>

    - Before supervised fitting, pretrain the encoders on prior-only sessions with masked-channel reconstruction and same-time versus time-shifted cross-stream discrimination. This learns present multi-stream state without future labels.
    - Use deterministic PyTorch, AdamW at `3e-4`, weight decay `1e-3`, cosine decay, at most 30 epochs, and five-epoch early stopping. Architecture and hyperparameters freeze before the official prequential replay.
    
    Policy:
    
    - When flat, calculate each side’s calibrated `q10(net)`, `P(net>0)`, and `q90(adverse excursion)`.
    - Require `q90(adverse excursion) ≤ $200`.
    - At each 21-session update, choose `P(net>0)` from `{0.50, 0.55, …, 0.90}` and a `q10` threshold from prior-score percentiles `{50,60,70,80,90,95,97.5,99}` using only the preceding 63 prior-only predictions.
    - A gate is admissible only if that trailing replay has positive mean and MDD no greater than $750. Select the highest mean; differences below $100/session tie, then the higher-confidence/fewer-trade gate wins. If none qualifies, abstain for that block.
    - At a cutoff where both sides qualify, take the side with larger `q10`; exact ties abstain. Trade count remains entirely emergent.
    
    ### 4. Run the fold-free proof and localize every shortfall
    
    Prequential protocol:
    
    - Sessions 0–61 seed the first model.
    - Generate warmup predictions causally for sessions 62–82, 83–103, and 104–124, retraining only on earlier sessions. These 63 predictions seed calibration.
    - Official scoring covers sessions 125–1002: 878 sessions. Retrain every 21 sessions on an expanding prior-only window; score the entire next block before admitting any of its outcomes.
    - Normalizers, representation pretraining, fitting, calibration, and policy selection obey the same cutoff.
    - Report both:
    
      - Mean on the 878 actually scored sessions.
      - Contract-equivalent mean over all 1,003 sessions with the 125 warmup sessions entered as zero. This preserves the original denominator and requires approximately $2,285 per scored session to clear the historical $2,000 floor.
    
    Promotion requires all of:
    
    - Zero-filled 1,003-session mean net at least $2,000.
    - Mean on the 878 scored sessions at least $2,000.
    - Cumulative EOD MDD strictly below $1,000.
    - No hard trade cap and exact one-position chronology.
    - Positive results in every calendar year reported, with concentration and leave-top-10 results disclosed.
    - Every score row identifies the model’s training cutoff and passes provenance validation.
    
    Required ablations use the identical protocol:
    
    - Aggregate baseline.
    - Slow proposal only.
    - Fast confirmation only.
    - Slow plus fast stock.
    - Add IWM option prints/surface.
    - Add RUTW cross-stream state.
    - Add OI/rates/forward-volatility state.
    - Add raw option-quote confirmation.
    
    If the floor is missed, route by measured decomposition:
    
    - Good paired direction but weak replay: repair calibration, timing, occupancy, or risk—not features.
    - Good direction and risk but poor fixed-15-minute economics: build state-change exits using the exact path authority.
    - Good signals whose value occurs between minute cutoffs: create a new sub-minute action book around detected transitions with fresh executable labels.
    - Train-only signal: reduce capacity and strengthen session/reflection invariance; do not reopen random feature grids.
    - No cross-session side signal after full raw-state and positive controls: inspect per-modality and cross-stream alignment losses, then test a learned transition candidate set. Do not use the discarded aggregate matrix to declare the raw data exhausted.
    
    After the first floor champion is frozen, pursue the “past the floor” lane by raising confidence to reduce median trades without a cap, then add state-change exits and multi-horizon value heads. The frozen floor champion remains untouched. The next promotion target is $3,000/session, MDD below $1,000, and median trades below ten.
    
    ## Test and escrow plan
    
    Mandatory tests include:
    
    - `LOW → long` and `HIGH → short`, demonstrated through the production target constructor; action-ID parity mutations must fail.
    - Post-cutoff raw perturbations leave every score byte-identical.
    - Shard permutation and equal-time cross-stream permutation leave tensors identical.
    - No option event sees a same-second future stock quote.
    - Whole-sweep vendor totals cannot appear before sweep completion.
    - Source condition, venue, unit-era, and missing-state mutations affect only their declared channels.
    - LOW/HIGH reflection swaps the two predicted value distributions.
    - Two identical compiler/model runs produce identical tensor and score artifacts.
    - A deliberately leaked future-return channel succeeds strongly; shuffled labels, shifted streams, and session permutations collapse to null.
    - The corrected aggregate and raw-state models use identical truth, calibration, policy, and replay.
    - 2026 paths are refused before escrow authorization.
    
    Escrow is two-stage and one-shot:
    
    1. Freeze and commit code, state schema, model, normalizers, calibrator, gate, input manifest, and expected output schema before opening any 2026 file.
    2. On authorization, compile and score the fixed 2026-07-16+ tranche, seal the score hash, and only then open outcome labels for replay. No retraining or threshold change is allowed between scoring and evaluation.
    
    The economic floor becomes confirmed only if the frozen escrow replay also produces at least $2,000/session and MDD below $1,000. Sample size and uncertainty are reported without changing the economic pass criteria.
    
    ## Implementation workflow and archive side quest
    
    - The root architect retains every scientific and architectural decision and writes an exact task card for each bounded implementation batch.
    - Every implementation batch is delegated only to `gpt-5.6-luna` with reasoning effort `max` and minimal forked context. Luna receives exact files, interfaces, formulas, failure cases, commands, and acceptance outputs; it does not select architecture or interpret results.
    - The root personally reads every diff, checks it against raw schemas and targets, runs the mutation test plus the full relevant suite, and accepts or rewrites the batch before issuing the next card.
    - Markdown, AGENTS instructions, skills, and Claude reports remain context only. No claim enters a task card without code, raw-data, or receipt-level verification.
    
    The archive is an early but separate task:
    
    - Build one importable, path-filtered Git fast-export covering all local branches/tags and unpushed commits, plus current authored text changes, source/configuration, every Markdown file, selected manifests/receipts, and a ref/SHA map.
    - Include tiny 2025-only schema samples with two or three rows for the six token feeds and the AllGreeks/OI/rate inputs used by this plan.
    - Exclude raw payloads, all 2026 data, generated matrices/runs, caches, worktrees, compiled targets, vendored binaries, secrets, media, and oversized Git blobs. Include an omission manifest and restoration instructions.
    - Package as a single `.tar.zst` with a hard 55 MB target, run `runpodctl send <archive>`, and return the receive code.
    - Do not rewrite local Git history or attempt the GitHub cleanup as part of this archive. The failed push is caused by tracked build artifacts and requires a separately authorized history rewrite.
    
    ## Assumptions
    
    - `select-v2@ab3940bc` is the sole current implementation baseline.
    - The preserved action book and entry-path targets remain read-only outcome authorities, but their fold columns are ignored.
    - No 2020–2021 data is used for scientific fitting, and no 2026 payload is read before escrow authorization.
    - The locally installed PyTorch and XGBoost stacks are used; the empty TabPFN environment and absent local checkpoint are not placed on the critical path.
    - The proven 418-bps availability establishes the physical opportunity, while reaching the causal floor remains something the new prequential and escrow protocols must earn.

    The logical distinction is this: the event generator creates eligible moments; the published $4,178 oracle then looks at each event-derived action’s **future** 15-minute net and keeps winners. So “the winner was inside the event set” proves coverage, but not yet that its identity was encoded in information available at the cutoff. It may be encoded—we have not run the right experiment. It may also be inflated if event eligibility or side assignment used future information, which is why your event-generation audit is essential.
    
    I’m therefore not accepting either extreme:
    
    - I will not assume the oracle is valid just because receipts call it verified.
    - I will not accept the prior “raw information exhausted” conclusion from reduced probes.
    - I will not build an open-ended exotic-model zoo.

The frontier work will be a small registered set—event-set encoders, residual surprise/predictive coding, marked point-process intensity, change-point/run-length state, competing first-passage risks, and symmetry-equivariant side valuation—each admitted only if it beats the corrected simple control under the same replay.     A serious quant process here means:
    
    - start from market mechanisms and executable decisions, not a model catalog;
    - measure whether an opportunity exists for each candidate, horizon, and exit before fitting;
    - preserve the full causal tape and treat side, timing, missingness, and schema eras as scientific variables;
    - use simple rules, statistical models, and deep models as competing instruments;
    - attack every apparent edge with independent reconstruction, nulls, time shifts, cost/occupancy mutations, prequential replay, and concentration analysis;
    - allocate research budget only after a mechanism shows incremental information and enough economic headroom;
    - keep generation and verification separate, like conjecture and proof.

    # Causal Action-State Rebuild and Identifiability Proof

    ## 2. Rebuild truth and the only evaluator
    
    ### Truth construction
    
    - Republish a keyed derivative of the preserved action book and path panel without changing either authority.
    - For paired measured rows:
    
    \[
    d=(LOW_{net}-HIGH_{net})/2,\qquad
    c=(LOW_{net}+HIGH_{net})/2
    \]
    
    \[
    LOW_{net}=c+d,\qquad HIGH_{net}=c-d
    \]
    
    - Preserve every unpaired, censored, and sign-indeterminate action as a typed state. Train paired directional objectives where both sides exist and masked direct-side objectives elsewhere.
    - Treat common drag as a prior-only rolling median friction term, not a large neural head; it is empirically narrow around approximately −$12. The learner concentrates capacity on directional distributions and risk.
    
    ### Rust floor evaluator
    
    - Fixed occupancy is the half-open interval `[cutoff_bar, cutoff_bar + 15)`.
    - P&L is the already-net `term_net_cent_15m`; costs are never added again.
    - Replay chronologically with one position and no trade cap.
    - At a cutoff, inspect both sides together and admit at most one.
    - Exact scientific score ties abstain. IDs and hashes never break ties.
    - Missing or censored 15-minute outcomes do not become zero.
    - Equity begins at zero, includes warmup and zero-trade days, and computes EOD drawdown from a zero-inclusive running peak.
    - Outputs include every candidate score, selected action and side, training cutoff, entry/exit time, realized net, daily equity, drawdown, trade count, yearly results, leave-top-10 result, top-day shares, and modality/model provenance.
    - Uncertainty uses 10,000 session-level stationary-bootstrap draws with mean block length 21. IID row bootstrap and IID sign flips are prohibited.
    
    Acceptance anchors:
    
    - `$100` hindsight gate (`best side net >= $100`): `$4,178.650110/session`, `20.0788` trades/session.
    - Exact positive-weight interval oracle: `$5,734.877846/session`, `21.8863` trades/session.

    - Charging the embedded cost again must reduce the threshold result to approximately `$4,062.9964`.

    ## 3. Compile the complete causal information set
    
    ### Normalized event authority
    
    Each normalized event carries:
    
    ```rust
    struct EventEnvelope {
        source: Source,
        event_kind: EventKind,
        ts_utc_ns: i64,
        timestamp_group: u64,
        source_sequence: Option<u64>,
        contract_key: Option<ContractKey>,
        validity: ValidityState,
        payload_offset: u64,
    }
    ```
    
    Validity distinguishes missing, one-sided, locked, crossed, unknown-condition, stale-attached, future-attached, ambiguous-join, saturated-Greek, and vendor-error states.
    
    Compiler rules:
    
    - Convert every naïve-Eastern raw timestamp through `corpus::SessionClock` into UTC. No Python timezone conversion or mixed-frame comparison is allowed.
    - Treat equal-time cross-stream events as unordered groups. Preserve same-source sequence only where its reliability is demonstrated.
    - K-way merge all expiry shards by timestamp. Filename or shard permutation must not change output.
    - Classify stock trades using their attached strictly prior NBBO only. Invalid or future attachment remains unclassified.
    - Use the latest stock spot strictly before an option event. A quote later in the same second is unavailable.
    - Reconstruct sweeps incrementally. Vendor whole-sweep size/count fields become visible only when the final member has occurred.
    - Ban `price_lead_1` at projection and schema-validation boundaries.
    - Normalize quote-size units using the measured 2025-11-03 semantic break, independent of Arrow dtype.
    - Handle interleaved stock schemas, the two wide IWM print days, mixed option-quote days, mixed AllGreeks days, and pre-option-quote coverage as explicit schema eras—not date guesses.
    - Join AllTradeGreeks to token option prints by exact multiset key `(timestamp, contract, price, size, exchange, condition)`. Ambiguous multiplicities remain typed; no first-match join.
    - Retain delta through third/higher-order Greeks, including speed, zomma, color, and ultima. Saturated `±21474.83647`, `iv_error`, padded surface rows, and zero/invalid IV states receive masks rather than clipping into ordinary values.
    - OI is usable only when its physical availability timestamp precedes session open; otherwise use the previous proven observation or mark it absent. Publish unsigned exposure and both dealer-sign scenarios.
    - Quarantine the current latest-vintage FRED JSON. Reacquire the six series with ALFRED real-time/vintage metadata. FRED defaults to information known today, not historically known information ([official documentation](https://fred.stlouisfed.org/docs/api/fred/realtime_period.html)). Apply a 24-hour availability lag unless an exact release timestamp is modeled; H.15 is posted after the trading session at 4:15 p.m. ([Federal Reserve](https://www.federalreserve.gov/Releases/h15/)), while SOFR is normally published around 8:00 a.m. and can be revised later that day ([New York Fed](https://www.newyorkfed.org/markets/reference-rates/additional-information-about-reference-rates)).
    - RUTW is context only. IWM remains the action clock, executable price, and P&L authority.
    
    ### State products
    
    - Exact event-group shards remain the information authority.
    - A streaming continuous-time encoder state is materialized at cutoffs using exact event gaps; no one-second ordering is invented.
    - Curated controls are also produced:
      - one-second fast summaries for stock quotes/trades and IWM/RUTW option prints/quotes;
      - one-minute slow summaries for path, realized volatility, IV surface level/skew/curvature/term structure, higher Greeks, OI scenarios, rates, forward volatility, clock, and modality quality.
    - Each family has at most 64 published columns and parallel validity masks. Normalization is never global; statistics are fitted from earlier training sessions.
    - The paired action index contains explicit side/direction and offsets into event, fast, and slow state. State is stored once per cutoff, not duplicated for LOW and HIGH.

    2. Build a 252-session science pilot: 63 evenly spaced, outcome-blind sessions per calendar year, plus required preceding context sessions.
    3. Compile the full 1,003-session core: stock quotes/trades, IWM/RUTW prints, AllTradeGreeks, AllGreeks, OI, and point-in-time rates.
    4. Compile the full available IWM and RUTW option-quote add-on. It must be measured before the existing information set can be called exhausted; if it consumes over 20% of total runtime and fails its add-on gate, it is removed from the production champion after its scientific test.
    
    Every modality receives an op-count and wall-time budget before implementation, a real-session probe, a four-control leakage harness, and two-run byte-identity check.
    
    ## 4. Prove identifiability, then train one fixed model ladder
    
    ### Economics-to-information ruler
    
    Before training a complex model:
    
    - Use the paired truth to inject controlled, session-independent score noise into the true directional ordering.
    - Replay each noise level through the exact policy to map within-session paired rank, side accuracy at selected coverage, top-tail dollar recall, and calibration into achievable dollars.
    - Freeze the empirically required information level instead of assuming the historical `~0.33` estimate.
    - Report how much of the required distance each real model closes. Volatility, survival, or MFE prediction cannot substitute for paired side identification.
    
    Mandatory controls:
    
    - Direct future-net leakage reproduces the exact oracle; a leaked-feature learner must recover at least 80% of the `$4,178.65` threshold ceiling.
    - Post-cutoff raw perturbations leave every legitimate score byte-identical.
    - Shuffled labels, shifted streams, reversed session assignments, and within-session matched nulls collapse to within `$100/session` of null and fail Holm significance.
    - Time-arrow discrimination is diagnostic only; success does not count as directional alpha.
    
    ### Fixed model ladder
    
    All arms use identical truth, rows, policy, replay, and folds:
    
    1. Side-and-clock null.
    2. Corrected aggregate XGBoost with explicit side.
    3. Causal-state XGBoost over the event-kernel, one-second, and slow summaries.
    4. Compact structured event model without raw option quotes.
    5. The same frozen model with the raw option-quote modality.
    
    XGBoost is fixed: CUDA histogram, depth 4, learning rate `0.03`, minimum child weight `32`, row/column subsampling `0.8`, L2 `10`, max bin `256`, at most 3,000 rounds, 100-round early stopping, seed `20260808`. Separate fixed fits produce mean and 10/50/90% quantiles.
    
    The primary neural model is capped at two million parameters:
    
    - Each event payload is projected to width 48.
    - Equal-timestamp groups use permutation-invariant sum/mean/max/count pooling.
    - Each modality updates a continuous-time state:
    
    \[
    \tilde h_t=h_{t^-}\odot e^{-\operatorname{softplus}(\lambda)\Delta t},
    \qquad
    h_t=\operatorname{GRUCell}(\operatorname{pool}(E_t),\tilde h_t)
    \]
    
    - Fixed decay initializations correspond to `50 ms, 250 ms, 1 s, 5 s, 30 s, 240 s`; decay rates remain learnable and positive.
    - A four-block depthwise causal TCN, width 32 and dilations `1/4/16/64`, processes the 240-second summary path.
    - A two-layer GRU, width 96, processes session-to-date minute state.
    - Minute option surfaces use a small set encoder over `(expiry, strike, right)` tokens, including higher Greeks, masks, and sign-scenario fields.
    - Two four-head attention layers fuse stock, IWM options, RUTW, surface, OI, and rate embeddings. Missing modalities use masks and learned missing tokens.
    - The slow branch emits a directional logit proposal. Exact-event/fast state supplies a bounded confirmation update `2*tanh(·)`.
    - Heads emit monotone directional q10/q50/q90, `P(net>0)`, q50/q90 adverse excursion, and discrete competing-risk hazards for favorable-first, adverse-first, or neither.
    - Primary transition target is `+$200 before −$100`; symmetric `+$100/−$100` and terminal 5/15/30/60-minute values are auxiliary targets. The first production policy remains 15 minutes.
    
    Training is deterministic AdamW at `3e-4`, weight decay `1e-3`, cosine decay, maximum 30 epochs, five-epoch patience, dropout `0.10`, session-balanced batches, modality dropout, causal time masking, price-scale invariance, and a 50% valid LOW/HIGH reflection augmentation. Loss weights are `1.0` directional Huber, `0.5` pinball, `0.5` paired ranking, `0.5` competing-risk, and `0.25` adverse excursion; ranking separation is clipped at `$500`.
    
    Pretraining uses masked-channel reconstruction and same-time versus time-shifted cross-stream discrimination. It receives only prior sessions: ten initial epochs, then two incremental epochs per 21-session update with a session-balanced replay sampler.
    
    A family survives the 252-session pilot only if it beats its matched null after Holm correction, improves paired rank by at least `0.01` or replay by at least `$100/session`, and is positive in at least four of five chronological comparisons. Differences below `$100/session` are unresolved. Full-core and raw-quote passes are still completed before a no-information verdict.
    
    ### Calibration, policy, and historical replay
    
    - Sessions `0–61` seed the model.
    - Generate prior-only warmup predictions for `62–82`, `83–103`, and `104–124`.
    - Score `125–1002` in 21-session blocks, retraining only on earlier sessions.
    - For early stopping, use the final 21 prior sessions as validation with a two-session embargo, determine epoch count, then refit on all prior sessions for that count.
    - Calibrate positive-net probabilities with session-weighted Platt scaling and quantiles with rolling empirical residual correction, using only the preceding 63 genuinely prequential predictions.
    - When flat, require calibrated `q10(net) > 0`, `P(net>0)` from `{0.50,0.55,…,0.90}`, and `q90(adverse) <= $200`.
    - Pair each probability threshold with q10 percentiles `{50,60,70,80,90,95,97.5,99}` from the same prior-only window.
    - A gate is admissible only when its trailing replay has positive mean and MDD no greater than `$750`.
    - Select the highest trailing mean. Results within `$100/session` tie; resolve by higher probability threshold, then higher q10 percentile, then fewer historical trades.
    - If neither side qualifies, abstain. If both qualify, choose the larger q10; exact equality abstains. Trade count is entirely emergent.
    
    Because 2022–2025 has already been repeatedly researched, this is a locked retrospective prequential proof, not a pristine holdout. Fold 7 is always labeled burned/contaminated-confirmatory.
    
    Promotion requires:
    
    - Zero-filled 1,003-session mean at least `$2,000`.
    - Mean on the 878 scored sessions at least `$2,000`.
    - Cumulative zero-inclusive EOD MDD strictly below `$1,000`.
    - Every calendar year positive.
    - Leave-top-10-out mean at least `$1,800`.
    - Exact one-position chronology, no trade cap, complete concentration reporting.
    - Every prediction identifies its training cutoff and passes provenance validation.
    
    Routing is mechanical:
    
    - Strong paired direction but weak replay → calibration, gate, or occupancy diagnosis.
    - Direction/risk heads pass but fixed 15-minute economics fail → state-change exits using the exact path authority.
    - Value appears between minute cutoffs → build a transition-triggered sub-minute action book with fresh executable labels; first require its perfect-foresight ceiling to exceed `$2,500/session`.
    - Train-only signal → reduce capacity and strengthen reflection/session invariance; do not open a feature grid.
    - No cross-session side signal after the complete core and raw option-quote pass → stop claiming the current information set can deliver the floor. Under the current data wall, any move to constituents, futures, or another leading instrument requires a new user authorization.
    
    ## 5. Minimal critical tests, anti-loop execution, and escrow
    
    ### Contract test suite
    
    Keep tests narrow and mutation-based:
    
    1. Production construction proves `LOW → Long` and `HIGH → Short`; ID/parity mutation fails.
    2. Paired formulas invert exactly and preserve typed unpaired/censored states.
    3. Evaluator anchors and all occupancy/side/cost mutations above.
    4. Post-cutoff raw poisoning leaves scores byte-identical.
    5. Shard permutation and equal-time cross-stream permutation leave state identical.
    6. No option event observes a same-time or same-second future stock quote.
    7. Vendor sweep totals remain hidden before completion.
    8. Schema, condition, venue, size-unit, missing-state, and saturated-Greek mutations affect only declared channels.
    9. OI and rate observations later than their availability cutoff are refused.
    10. LOW/HIGH reflection swaps side-value distributions and negates directional output.
    11. Two complete compiler/model runs produce identical state and score hashes.
    12. Leak control succeeds; label/stream/session nulls collapse.
    13. Aggregate and raw-state arms share exact truth, calibration, policy, and replay identities.
    14. Every 2026 path is refused before escrow authorization.
    
    Every test is first run against a deliberate mutation and shown to fail. No broad snapshot collection or low-value boilerplate is added.
    
    ### Anti-loop implementation workflow
    
    - The architect freezes one vertical-slice task card before coding. It names exact inputs, interfaces, formulas, allowed files, runtime budget, mutation, command, and expected artifact.
    - Sonnet/Opus implementers execute cards but do not choose architecture or reinterpret results. Worktrees never overlap writable files.
    - Each slice is self-tested, then the architect reads the complete diff, checks raw schemas/formulas, and runs its acceptance command.
    - One fresh refute-first review follows, strictly against the locked card. A genuine implementation defect receives one correction pass. If the same defect class recurs, the architect rewrites or discards the slice instead of beginning another review/fix cycle.
    - Reviewer suggestions that expand scope become later task cards; they do not block an accepted slice.
    - Commits remain small and vertical. Shared readers, clocks, validity states, and publication code are implemented once. Killed experiment code is removed before the next phase.
    - Long jobs use `lab/run.sh`, heartbeat/watchdog monitoring, the mandated Cargo target directory, and exact-PID termination.
    - Trial registration is append-only and occurs before execution. Failed and null trials remain in the ledger.
    
    ### 2026 escrow
    
    1. Freeze and commit compiler, schema, model weights, normalizers, calibrator, gate, input manifest, expected score schema, and score command before authorizing any 2026 access.
    2. After explicit authorization, compile and score the fixed `2026-07-16+` tranche, seal score hashes, then open outcome labels for replay. No retraining, threshold change, candidate change, or exit change is permitted.
    
    The economic floor is confirmed only if the frozen escrow replay also produces at least `$2,000/session` and MDD below `$1,000`. Sample size and uncertainty are reported separately and do not rewrite the contract.

    The first cross-domain mechanism that survives initial scrutiny is more specific than “use a neural net”:
    
    Solar-flare forecasting treats observed bursts as incomplete projections of a hidden stress field. It assimilates the past event sequence into an ensemble of latent states, then forecasts from the ensemble because many hidden configurations can reproduce the same observations. That is directly relevant to our options surface: strike/expiry quote pressure, prints, higher Greeks, and stock flow are partial observations of a latent stress/absorption state.
    
    But the paper’s headline is not evidence we should copy its model. Its real-data study manually rescales time and energy, selects only 11 flare-rich regions, uses a crude accuracy measure, and admits it cannot compute a proper observed-climatology skill score. The transferable hypothesis is therefore narrow: test whether an ensemble latent-state assimilator adds causal information beyond recent-window summaries. A cheap pilot must beat the same truth/replay before any sandpile-like system enters the build.


### 2026-08-08T19:59:59.710Z — ASSISTANT (ordinal 5501, id msg_0fbef113a6e13454016a778ab98aec8191b8b74b3c2482fe1c)

Provenance: line 5502, bytes [92707101,92708526), text SHA-256 `1df5137900fe71a4db3de43880453e55649f79cd739489d84cc49bd7f496b20e`.

    The transition literature gives us two useful constraints, not a license to add more complexity:
    
    - Bayesian online changepoint detection is genuinely causal, but its standard form assumes IID observations inside each regime and requires a chosen hazard prior. It should be a small control on typed stream summaries, not the core model.
    - Critical-slowing indicators and synthetic bifurcation pretraining only apply when a system drifts slowly toward a local transition. They can miss shock-driven or chaotic changes and are highly sensitive to detrending, window length, sampling rate, and rising external noise. One highly cited deep model also tuned by grid sweeps, chose some transition times by eye, generated nulls from fitted AR(1) processes, and admits it cannot predict transition timing.
    
    So the plan will not assume “market = bifurcation.” These become a preregistered, low-cost family with explicit nulls and a kill gate. The stronger general lesson is to train on mechanistic invariants only after proving that those invariants are present in our tape.

### 2026-08-08T20:14:19.554Z — ASSISTANT (ordinal 5850, id msg_0fbef113a6e13454016a778e167e9c8191a7c5f30246fa36a8)

    The ranking batch is also narrowing the plan:
    
    - Class-conditional noise theory assumes label flips independent of features and constant across queries; our payoff noise is continuous, state-dependent, temporally dependent, and censored. Its “noise-tolerant” losses do not transfer.
    - Wasserstein robust ranking used random five-fold validation and artificial test perturbations. It does not demonstrate robustness to chronological regime change.
    - Differentiable top‑k and decision-focused combinatorial training assume a fixed candidate set is visible when the decision is optimized. Our policy is online, uncapped, and cannot see future cutoffs. Using a whole-session differentiable selector would be leakage.
    - Therefore no fixed top‑k, soft-sort, Sinkhorn selector, or session-level differentiable optimizer belongs in the primary lane. The valid unit remains the current cutoff: LOW, HIGH, or abstain, with replay used for prior-only policy calibration.
    
    That removes substantial complexity from the earlier plan rather than adding research-flavored machinery.

    <proposed_plan>
    # Action-State Rebuild: Evidence-Gated Route to the $2,000 Floor
    
    ## 1. Summary and locked evidence
    
    Implement from clean `select-v2@ab3940bc` on branch `select-v2/action-state-rebuild`. Extend the existing `select_v2` Rust crate and add one isolated `engine/py/select_live` package; do not create another Rust crate, evaluator, trainer framework, or feature-search lab.
    
    The plan distinguishes capacity from learnability:
    
    - All 773,661 actions were independently scanned: unique IDs, valid registered days/bars, explicit sides, and zero `known_at ≥ cutoff` violations.
    - The authoritative $100 hindsight policy is $4,178.65/session, $4,072.45 leave-top-10-out, and 20,139 trades. The exact one-position oracle is $5,734.88/session and $5,588.42 leave-top-10-out.
    - A new full-corpus raw-NBBO stress retained $4,159.27/session and $4,054.29 leave-top-10-out at one-second entry latency; its exact oracle remained $5,731.38/session. Every year stayed positive. Physical opportunity therefore survives realistic reaction delay.
    - Learnability is not yet established. Old aggregate, print-summary, surface, and local-analog probes produced payoff-weighted directional accuracy of approximately 50.0%, 50.3%, 51.2%, and 49.9%; confidence tails did not hold. Future-leak controls succeed strongly, proving the pipelines can detect signal when information exists.
    - Real-payoff simulations indicate that the selected region likely needs roughly 85–88% correct-side decisions, depending on timing selectivity. This is a diagnostic, not a substitute promotion metric.
    - Therefore do not claim a current >90% probability of success. Award an internal `HIGH_ASSURANCE` label only after the locked replay and bootstrap gates below; only the one-shot forward escrow can confirm the economic claim.
    
    The cross-domain research sweep changes the representation, not the evidence standard:
    
    - Translate physics/ecology/control ideas into observable effort-response elasticity, residual propagation, recruitment, defense decay, and transition/handoff state.
    - Treat options as supply, state, and response information—not automatically informed direction—because stock often initiates option/stock price discovery and dealer-sign assumptions are weak.
    - Keep BOCPD, price-only Preisach models, quantum analogies, teacher/LUPI learning, generic contrastive pretraining, and copied meta-labeling frameworks out of the default path. Existing tests gave them no implementation warrant.
    - The revised 0DTE paper’s abstract suggests hedging-driven reversals, but actual PDF/formulas were not lawfully retrievable; it remains contextual only ([official SSRN record](https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=5641974)).
    - Maintain a research register containing version, venue, lawful route, local SHA, formula pages, assumptions, proposed transfer, control, real-slice result, and keep/kill decision. Commit PDFs only when redistribution is permitted.
    
    ## 2. Truth, evaluator, interfaces, and provenance
    
    ### Typed truth spine
    
    Use explicit types everywhere:
    
    ```text
    ActionKey {
        session_ordinal: u32,
        cutoff_bar_ordinal: u16,
        extreme_side: LOW | HIGH,
    }
    
    TradeDirection {
        LOW  -> Long,
        HIGH -> Short,
    }
    
    PairedTarget {
        low_net_cent: Option<i64>,
        high_net_cent: Option<i64>,
        directional_x2_cent: Option<i64>,  // low - high
        common_drag_x2_cent: Option<i64>,  // low + high
        value_state,
        direction_state,
    }
    ```
    
    No ordinal, row parity, action-ID suffix, digest, hash, or serialization order may infer side or resolve a tie.
    
    Build `truth_actions` and `truth_pairs` through `ActionKey` from these pinned authorities:
    
    - Action book manifest: `ffa9dc4b0cf5d0a9b8353886e8ddd882d62337b68164395e1d80a87cf012e9c5`.
    - Structural actions manifest: `b75c6530d9dcf172eced4671784797590ed46533714f1de27ece0ffe113315e4`.
    - Entry-path target manifest: `8331fac3fb59a45b83093a6b4679cc47a0387cd5cc4c03617391d702b7fc41a0`.
    
    Pin the measured geometry:
    
    - 773,661 actions; 386,819 LOW and 386,842 HIGH.
    - 385,709 paired cutoffs and 2,243 unpaired cutoffs.
    - 371,709 paired/both-measured; 14,000 paired/both-censored.
    - 2,209 unpaired/measured; 34 unpaired/censored.
    - 3,814 measured directional ties; all are losing and receive zero ranking weight.
    - 745,627 measured 15-minute actions and 28,034 `FIXED_HORIZON_PAST_CLOSE`.
    
    Use the existing exact target constructor:
    
    ```text
    LOW gross  = exit_bid - entry_ask
    HIGH gross = entry_bid - exit_ask
    net_cent   = trunc(gross_fraction_u6) * 10 - 576
    ```
    
    Targets already contain spread and the 576-cent round-trip cost. Never add cost again. Censored rows remain typed; paired losses train jointly, unpaired measured rows train direct side heads, and censored rows are masked.
    
    ### Rust evaluator
    
    Add one authoritative Rust evaluator to `select_v2`:
    
    - Fixed occupancy `[cutoff, cutoff + 15 minutes)`; re-entry is allowed exactly at nominal exit.
    - Process both sides jointly at a cutoff and take at most one.
    - Select only while flat; no trade cap.
    - Exact quantized score ties abstain.
    - Equity starts at zero; include warmup and zero-trade days.
    - MDD is cumulative EOD drawdown against a zero-inclusive running peak.
    - Emit all candidate scores, gate decisions, selected actions, nominal/actual exit time, realized already-net cents, daily equity, drawdown, trade count, yearly results, top-session concentration, and leave-top-10 results.
    
    Acceptance anchors:
    
    | Mutation | Expected mean/session |
    |---|---:|
    | Correct $100 hindsight replay | $4,178.6501 |
    | Exact DP oracle | $5,734.8778 |
    | 14-minute occupancy | $4,442.7308 |
    | 16-minute occupancy | $3,962.9238 |
    | LOW/HIGH mapping swapped | −$4,671.5694 |
    | Cost subtracted twice | $4,062.9964 |
    
    Also publish non-binding 0 ms, 100 ms, and 1 s entry-latency replays. The full-corpus one-second result above is the required capacity anchor; it does not replace THE evaluator.
    
    ### Public commands and publication
    
    Extend the binary with:
    
    - `inventory`: create the exact 2022–2025 source allowlist, schema/unit eras, sizes, and hashes.
    - `truth`: publish keyed action/pair truth and latency diagnostics.
    - `compile --mode core|quotes`: publish causal per-session state.
    - `publish-scores`: validate and canonicalize Python scratch outputs.
    - `evaluate`: run policy replay and assurance analysis.
    - `verify`: recompute hashes, provenance, chronology, and required leaves.
    
    Python exposes only:
    
    ```text
    python -m select_live prequential --spec ... --arm ... --scratch ...
    python -m select_live escrow-score --spec ... --scratch ...
    ```
    
    Python scratch is never authority. Rust publishes under:
    
    ```text
    artifacts/runs/select_live/<stage>/<run_id>/
    ```
    
    `run_id` is SHA-256 over canonical spec bytes, ordered schema hash, clean Git SHA, producer version, and ordered input-manifest hash. Official runs refuse dirty specs, stage beside the destination, atomically rename without replacement, and refuse an existing destination. One manifest records command, all inputs, schemas, per-file hashes, and every block’s model, normalizer, calibrator, fit cutoff, and calibration cutoff.
    
    Scores use fixed wire units: predicted net/adverse in signed millicents, probability in unsigned ppb, realized values in cents, no NaNs, and explicit state masks.
    
    ## 3. Causal state and selector
    
    ### Source and clock contract
    
    Consume:
    
    - IWM stock quotes and trades.
    - IWM option prints and raw quotes.
    - RUTW option prints and raw quotes as context only.
